scenes.label: One connected school run
narration: Carribu connects families, drivers, and the school office.

scenes.label: From home to the school gates
narration: From home, to pickup, and on to the school gates.
Follow recorded trip updates and the latest available bus location.

scenes.label: For families
narration: For families, see linked children and their assigned transport.
Check recorded pickup and drop-off updates, and contact the driver.

scenes.label: For drivers
narration: For drivers, review assigned trips and the student list.
Record pickups, absences, and drop-offs as the run progresses.

scenes.label: For the school office
narration: For the school office, manage students, routes, vehicles, and drivers in one workspace.
Review trip progress with the actual Carribu admin dashboard.

scenes.label: Prepare, pilot and roll out
narration: Preview new students, updates, and errors before import.
Pilot with staff, then roll out to families.
